name: filter.currencyIn
title: Field: filter.currencyIn
description: Meaning and invariants of the buyer query filter.currencyIn field.
meaning: Allowed currencies for listing prices in the result set.

invariants.label: Price interpretation
invariants.value: This constrains the currency of listing prices, not priceType.

text:
# filter.currencyIn

TL;DR:
- filter.currencyIn narrows search to selected price currencies.

What it means:
- Returned listings must use one of the specified currency codes.

Agent hint:
- Use it when price currency matters, especially in mixed-currency browsing surfaces.
